Jane · Listen & Shadow 06

The Friday Report — reporting back, rebuilding trust
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · THE STACK
👤 Friend
How many papers travel with one box?
상자 하나에 서류가 몇 장이나 같이 다녀요?
travel with ~ — ~와 함께 다니다
💬 Jane
Six. Without any one of them, the drug can't be used.
여섯 장이요. 하나라도 없으면 약이 있어도 못 써요.
without — ~ 없이
같은 패턴으로 — Without the permit, it can't cross the border. · Without the log, the data can't be used.
💬 Jane
The packing list has the lot numbers and the quantities.
명세서에는 로트 번호와 수량이 적혀 있어요.
packing list — 포장 명세서 · lot number — 제조 단위 번호 · quantity — 수량
같은 패턴으로 — The packing list shows what's supposed to be inside. · The list has one line per lot.
💬 Jane
The site counts the boxes against it.
병원에서는 그걸 보고 수를 맞춰요.
site — 시험 기관(병원) · count against ~ — ~와 대조해 세다
같은 패턴으로 — The warehouse counts against the list. · We count every box against the manifest.
💬 Jane
The import permit has to be arranged in advance, country by country.
수입 허가는 나라마다 미리 받아야 해요.
import permit — 수입 허가 · in advance — 미리 · country by country — 나라마다
같은 패턴으로 — The permit has to be renewed every year. · Each country has its own permit.
💬 Jane
No permit, no border.
허가가 없으면 국경을 못 넘어요.
border — 국경
같은 패턴으로 — No signature, no delivery. · No log, no data.
PART 2 · THE LOGGER
👤 Friend
What about the temperature logger?
온도 기록계는 어떻게 되는 거예요?
logger — 기록계
💬 Jane
A logger rides inside the box the whole way.
기록계가 상자 안에 같이 타고 다녀요.
ride — (실려서) 가다 · the whole way — 끝까지
같은 패턴으로 — A tracker rides inside. · The sensor rides with the shipment.
💬 Jane
You read it before you open the box.
열기 전에 기록부터 봐요.
read — (기록을) 확인하다
같은 패턴으로 — You check it before you sign. · You read the log before anything else.
💬 Jane
If it went out of range, the drug can't be used — and the data may not count.
온도가 벗어났으면, 그 약은 못 쓰고 데이터도 무효가 될 수 있어요.
out of range — 허용 범위를 벗어난 · count — 유효하다
같은 패턴으로 — If it went out of range for an hour, the whole box is lost. · If the seal is broken, it doesn't count.
💬 Jane
Thirty minutes out of range — I'd flag the sponsor before the site.
30분 벗어난 거면, 병원이 아니라 스폰서한테 먼저 알릴 거예요.
flag — 알리다 · sponsor — 의뢰 제약사
같은 패턴으로 — I'd flag QA before customs. · I'd flag it to my manager first.
PART 3 · CUSTODY AND CLOSE
👤 Friend
What does the chain of custody record?
인수 기록은 뭘 남겨요?
chain of custody — 인수 기록(누가 언제 받았는지)
💬 Jane
Every handoff — factory, depot, customs, site pharmacy.
손이 바뀐 지점을 전부요 — 공장, 창고, 세관, 병원 약국까지.
handoff — 인수인계 · depot — 창고
같은 패턴으로 — Every handoff, with a time and a name. · Every stop along the way.
💬 Jane
Even the time it sat in the customs hold shows up.
세관 대기 구역에 있던 시간까지 남아요.
customs hold — 세관 대기 · show up — 나타나다, 기록에 남다
같은 패턴으로 — Even the wait at the airport shows up. · Every hour shows up on the record.
💬 Jane
The accountability log says who got what and what came back.
장부에는 누구에게 몇 개 줬고 뭐가 돌아왔는지 적어요.
accountability log — 약품 관리 장부
같은 패턴으로 — The log says what was used and what was returned. · It shows every dose.
💬 Jane
At study close, you need a certificate saying the leftovers were destroyed.
시험이 끝나면 남은 약을 폐기했다는 증명서가 필요해요.
study close — 시험 종료 · certificate — 증명서 · leftover — 남은 것
같은 패턴으로 — At the end, you need proof it was destroyed. · You need a certificate for every lot.
PART 4 · THE FEDEX VERSION
👤 Friend
Did FedEx have anything like these?
FedEx에도 비슷한 게 있었어요?
anything like ~ — ~ 비슷한 것
💬 Jane
The closest thing we had was the customs form and the packing list.
제일 비슷한 건 통관 서류랑 포장 명세서였어요.
the closest thing — 제일 가까운 것
같은 패턴으로 — The closest thing was the delivery receipt. · The closest thing we had was a tracking number.
💬 Jane
The temperature log and the destruction certificate have no equivalent.
온도 기록이나 폐기 증명은 대응되는 게 없어요.
equivalent — 대응되는 것
같은 패턴으로 — The custody chain has no equivalent. · That one has no equivalent at all.
💬 Jane
There, arrival was the end. Here, arrival is the start.
거기선 상자가 도착하면 끝이었죠. 여기선 도착이 시작이에요.
arrival — 도착
같은 패턴으로 — There, the signature was the end. · Here, the paperwork starts after delivery.
느리게 20/20 · 보통 20/20
